responsibility: This definition module declares the gm2 wrapper around the host select(2) readiness API and related raw file-descriptor utilities. It belongs to the runtime OS event/multiplexing layer and exposes opaque ADDRESS-based SetOfFd and Timeval handles plus operations to allocate, free, inspect, and modify fd sets and timeout records, invoke Select, compute max-fd-plus-one, perform unbuffered character I/O on raw descriptors, and fetch wall-clock time with GetTimeOfDay. It is the low-level readiness interface used beneath higher-level event code such as RTint.
